decisions: Treat Bitquery's rDAE53 attribution as a secondary-source label to Binance's published PoR address list. Do not treat it as proof of membership in the 1 October 2026 XRP reserve numerator until the exact list version and XRP asset row are verified.

Record the 185,017,485.5 XRP rDAE53 transfer as a separate conditional stress case: if it depleted the October 1 XRP PoR numerator, the rounded 100.77%/2.496B baseline yields about 93.36% modeled coverage and 165.798M XRP shortfall before offsets. This is not an observed reserve ratio and is excluded from forecasts.
Keep the other four incident source wallets as PoR-membership unknown; do not generalize rDAE53's label to the cluster.
Resolve Japanese SBIC as three statutory regional companies: Tokyo SBIC East Japan, Nagoya SBIC Central Japan and Osaka SBIC West Japan. Keep them distinct from SBI Holdings.
Classify the 26 February 2025 Tokyo SBIC ChatGPT event as education/co-hosted seminar with a Microsoft speaker, not OpenAI partnership, investment or product integration.
Classify the film-industry Camilla Stephenson as an identity candidate only. Do not equate her with Kamilah Stevenson or assign any YouTube channel/video list without primary channel evidence.
invariants: Bitquery's label source is the published PoR list, but its snapshot date and XRP asset mapping remain unspecified.
A PoR address label does not establish beneficial ownership or an asset balance at a historical snapshot.
The 93.36% calculation is conditional and cannot be represented as actual post-incident XRP reserve coverage.
Japanese SBIC is three companies defined by statute; the letters SBI in their English abbreviations do not prove an affiliation with SBI Holdings.
The ChatGPT seminar is not evidence of an OpenAI partnership.
No YouTube channel identity for the intended Camilla Stephenson has been verified.
